cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example sprawl --palette arctic --seed 7 --output examples/output/sprawl-arctic.png
cases.explanation: Balanced branching across a rectangular canvas with bounded reseeding.
cases.limitation: A node target is an upper goal, not a guarantee of complete packing.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example typography --palette arctic --seed 7 --output examples/output/typography-arctic.png
cases.explanation: Graph growth wraps around a measured text rectangle; padding scales with font size.
cases.limitation: The exclusion is a rectangle, not individual glyph outlines.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example density --palette linen --seed 7 --output examples/output/density-linen.png
cases.explanation: Desired population and spacing vary smoothly from dense left to sparse right.
cases.limitation: Density is in nodes per square world unit and remains a packing heuristic.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example raster --palette blueprint --seed 7 --output examples/output/raster-blueprint.png
cases.explanation: A small scalar image creates a dense central band using world-coordinate bilinear interpolation.
cases.limitation: Row zero maps to minimum y; a lower-resolution raster smooths small features.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example scale --palette aurora --seed 7 --output examples/output/scale-aurora.png
cases.explanation: Rings, gaps, buffers, lengths, and stroke widths grow together across the canvas.
cases.limitation: Large geometry can displace small details; field feasibility is not guaranteed.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example obstacles --palette porcelain --seed 7 --output examples/output/obstacles-porcelain.png
cases.explanation: Full nodes and strokes stay inside a concave outline and outside an internal obstacle.
cases.limitation: Exact containment does not imply every narrow pocket will be filled.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example band --palette forest --seed 7 --output examples/output/band-forest.png
cases.explanation: Grow within a finite-width band around a supplied polygon.
cases.limitation: This uses supplied polygons; importing glyphs or SVG paths is deferred.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example follow --palette arctic --seed 7 --output examples/output/follow-arctic.png
cases.explanation: Bias growth along a boundary while retaining interior branches.
cases.limitation: Experimental: gaps can remain and a closed boundary loop is not promised.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example terminate --palette orchid --seed 7 --output examples/output/terminate-orchid.png
cases.explanation: Bias branch tips toward the region boundary.
cases.limitation: Experimental: terminal anchoring can remain unmet; inspect the contour report.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example cooperate --palette ember --seed 7 --output examples/output/cooperate-ember.png
cases.explanation: Two colored colonies attract and can join through validated component bridges.
cases.limitation: Joining is a permission, not a guaranteed connection; ownership survives a join.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example compete --palette forest --seed 7 --output examples/output/compete-forest.png
cases.explanation: Colony headings turn away while an explicit rival gap separates rings and full strokes.
cases.limitation: Repulsion alone does not guarantee clearance; weights grant attempts, not area.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example loops --palette blueprint --seed 7 --output examples/output/loops-blueprint.png
cases.explanation: Additional short edges close existing components after branch growth.
cases.limitation: Every loop must still pass collision, degree, and both-endpoint angle checks.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example newest --palette linen --seed 7 --output examples/output/newest-linen.png
cases.explanation: Select the most recent active node for winding, less evenly distributed growth.
cases.limitation: An explicit parent policy cannot be combined with coverage scheduling or colonies.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example quality --palette porcelain --seed 7 --output examples/output/quality-porcelain.png
cases.explanation: A hard 40-degree limit and preferred 75-degree angle reduce sharp clusters; refill retries freed space.
cases.limitation: Stricter aesthetic constraints can increase rejection and underfill.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example angles_free --palette porcelain --seed 7 --output examples/output/angles_free-porcelain.png
cases.explanation: No hard or soft angle rule: more acute junctions can survive.
cases.limitation: Collision checks still forbid overlapping strokes.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example angles_hard --palette porcelain --seed 7 --output examples/output/angles_hard-porcelain.png
cases.explanation: Reject every junction below 45 degrees.
cases.limitation: This can reduce feasible connections.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example angles_soft --palette porcelain --seed 7 --output examples/output/angles_soft-porcelain.png
cases.explanation: Prefer 80 degrees with a 0.9 soft penalty, without a hard angle ban.
cases.limitation: Soft penalties can still accept sharp angles.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example angles_strict --palette porcelain --seed 7 --output examples/output/angles_strict-porcelain.png
cases.explanation: Combine a 60-degree ban with a 90-degree preference.
cases.limitation: Stricter controls may leave more open space.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example shapes --palette porcelain --seed 7 --output examples/output/shapes-porcelain.png
cases.explanation: Hexagonal hollow nodes retain the same reserved radius as circles.
cases.limitation: Collision and edge clipping use conservative enclosing disks.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example lines --palette blueprint --seed 7 --output examples/output/lines-blueprint.png
cases.explanation: Parallel strokes share a single reserved full-width corridor.
cases.limitation: Style changes do not open gaps in collision protection.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example arctic_atlas --palette arctic --seed 7 --output examples/output/arctic_atlas-arctic.png
cases.explanation: A broad, dense name composition intended for close inspection at full resolution.
cases.limitation: Large output takes more generation, validation, and export time.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example panorama --palette aurora --seed 7 --output examples/output/panorama-aurora.png
cases.explanation: A wide network with a coordinated wave in scale and a central title.
cases.limitation: A high node target may still leave local gaps.

cases.command: python -m graph_ics render --example archipelago --palette blueprint --seed 7 --output examples/output/archipelago-blueprint.png
cases.explanation: Three colonies claim a large canvas around obstacle islands with hard rival gaps.
